title: Lewis acid-promoted intramolecular cyclization of ortho-prenylated chalcones: application to first total synthesis of (±) involucrasin C and its novel analogues
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27254-27259
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04830C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jarish Ahamad, Rashmi Ranjan Khatua, Faiz Ahmed Khan
This study presents a refinement of a synthetic protocol for the diastereoselective intramolecular ene-type cyclization of ortho-prenylated chalcones using ZnCl2, leading to the corresponding tertiary alcohols sans the undesired alkene by-product.
